रोपः [रुह्-णिच् हस्य पः कर्मणि अच्]
1 The act of raising or setting up.
--2 Planting.
--3 An arrow;
[]
Śi. 19. 120.
--4 A hole, cavity.

रोपणं [रुह्-णिच् हस्य पः ल्युट्]
1 The
act of erecting, setting up or
raising.
--2 Planting.
--3 Healing.
--4 A
healing application (said of sores).

रोपित p. p.
1 Planted, set up.
--2
Erected, raised.
--3 Entrusted,
devolved on; see रुह् caus.
